name: unifi-hostapd
description: Parses hostapd WiFi station events (association, deauthentication, WPA handshake) as emitted by UniFi access points and plain Linux hostapd. Matches the header-stripped syslog message: 'IFACE: STA MAC MODULE: event'.

test_samples.description: WPA EAPOL frame exchange (high-volume handshake chatter)
test_samples.input: wifi0ap1: STA aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:01 WPA: received EAPOL-Key frame (2/4 Pairwise)

test_samples.description: Station deauthentication is classified as wifi_event deauthenticated
test_samples.input: wifi1ap2: STA aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:02 IEEE 802.11: deauthenticated due to local deauth request

test_samples.description: Disassociation classifies before the broader 'associated' match
Invalid MIC in the 4-way handshake marks an authentication failure (possible WPA cracking)
test_samples.input: wlan0: STA aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:04 WPA: invalid MIC in msg 2/4 of 4-Way Handshake

test_samples.description: Completed pairwise handshake marks an authentication success
test_samples.input: wifi0ap1: STA aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:05 WPA: pairwise key handshake completed (RSN)

metadata.author: siembox
metadata.log_source: hostapd (UniFi access points, Linux hostapd) via syslog
